name: TMA-P003_seg
encoding: little-endian per tile: Uint32 idx[n] (index into the point order of the point file), Uint8 nverts[n] + zero pad to 4 bytes, Uint16 coords[2*nv] (x,y per vertex, cells in idx order, open rings); v = x0 - pad + q/65535*(tile_um + 2*pad), same for y; um, y down; cells assigned to tiles by centroid
simplification: Douglas-Peucker from 0.4 um, raised per cell (x1.5 steps) until <= 12 vertices; >= 3 vertices
source: raw Xenium cell boundaries (cell_boundaries.parquet) of the run holding these cells
